_notes.verification_status: All 3 names confirmed in 5 production recipes in a live Workato workspace, and re-confirmed by activation-testing a scratch recipe (wk recipes start) against the same workspace. Re-verified in a second pass against 2 additional production bot_command recipes and their shared callable-recipe dependency (get teamsID from_liferayID) -- no new names surfaced, but new field-level detail did (see below and SKILL.md).
_notes.get_user_by_principal_name: Observed with two different input fields across different recipes: `principal_name` (email/UPN) in one recipe, `id` (Azure AD object ID, typically sourced from the bot_command trigger's context.from.aadObjectId) in three others. Both are real, live-verified inputs to the same action -- likely alternate lookup modes on one field, but no toggleCfg was captured in any of the source recipes to confirm that formally.
_notes.bot_command_parameters: Parameter `type`/`control_type` pairs confirmed in production: string/text, and date_time/date (with parse_output/render_input: date_conversion on the corresponding extended_output_schema entry). The `file` type mentioned in Workato's own Workbot-for-Teams documentation has not been observed in any recipe in this workspace and is NOT included here or assumed to work.
_notes.post_blocks_message_blocks: text_block's text_type has been observed as both body_text and custom (the latter paired with separator/style.isSubtle for a de-emphasized footer line). text_with_button_block's button_type has only been observed as submit. Neither of these is a new action/trigger name -- see SKILL.md's Block Types Reference for details.
_notes.workbotguide_gap: Workato's own Workbot-for-Teams documentation (docs.workato.com) additionally describes a New help message trigger, a Tab opened trigger, a New message trigger (beta), a Delete message action, a Get user info action (already covered here as get_user_by_principal_name), a Show tab using Adaptive Cards action, and a generic custom action for Microsoft Graph API calls. NONE of these appear in any recipe in this workspace, so none are added here. `wk recipes import` was confirmed NOT to validate action/trigger names against the live connector (a fabricated trigger name imports without error), so import success alone cannot be used as verification -- only production usage or activation-testing (wk recipes start) counts, and activation-testing every one of these would risk live side effects on a connected Teams tenant (e.g. New help message trigger is a bot-wide singleton). Left unverified rather than guessed.
_notes.unverified: No other action or trigger name has been verified against a live connector. Do not add names here from vendor API docs or general knowledge alone.
